title: Addicted To You - Avicii & Audra Mae

lines.l: Wasn't looking where I was going
You came into my crazy world
Like a cool and cleansing rain
Before I, I knew what hit me, baby
You were flowing through my veins
Hooked on your love, like a powerful drug, I can't get enough, oh, I'm lost in your eyes, drowning in blue, out of control, what can I do? I'm addicted to you.
The night blows in through the window
I'm getting high on the perfume
I couldn't live without you now
I wouldn't last one night alone, baby
